title: Add User Bio Update Logging Event
description: The SocialStitch Portfolio Hub needs enhanced audit capabilities. Currently, changes to user profiles are not explicitly logged, making it difficult to track user activity or debug issues related to profile data. This task involves introducing a new log event that is triggered specifically when a user updates their portfolio biography. The task is designed to be completed over multiple sessions to simulate a standard, interruptible development workflow.

project_spec.name: SocialStitch Portfolio Hub
project_spec.description:
SocialStitch Portfolio Hub is an expert-level, socially-oriented web-portfolio platform written entirely in C. More than a conventional personal-site generator, SocialStitch transforms each user’s portfolio into an interactive social node, allowing visitors to follow, comment, react, and collaborate on showcased projects. Creators can curate project timelines, share media-rich updates, and cross-promote content through built-in social feeds and activity streams.

The application is engineered around Clean Architecture principles, strictly separating entities, use-cases, interface adapters, and frameworks. A Component-Architecture slices the codebase into independently testable modules: Authentication, Social Graph, Portfolio Management, Notification, and Payment. REST API endpoints expose the core services, while a responsive MVC front-end (HTML5/JS/CSS generated by a small C template engine) consumes those APIs. The design supports sophisticated features—secure file uploads, real-time search, social logins, caching, SSL termination, and an admin panel—while preserving maintainability and enabling high-performance execution native to C.
dependencies: libmicrohttpd (fallback lightweight HTTP server for tests)
mujs or QuickJS-C binding (embedded JS for template logic)
